item.title: Lower education and birthplace linked to lower ICU admission rates in Sweden during COVID-19
item.description: A Swedish study found that COVID-19 patients with less education or from outside Northwestern Europe/North America were less likely to be admitted to intensive care.

item.title: Q&A: Minimally invasive procedure combines diagnosis, staging, and surgery for lung cancer
item.description: Early-stage lung cancer patients typically undergo multiple procedures over weeks. A new approach aims to streamline diagnosis, staging, and treatment into one minimally invasive step.

item.title: Resident's personal statement effort questioned: Why not use AI? [PODCAST]
item.description: A resident spent weeks on a personal statement, then a reader asked why she didn't use AI. This podcast explores that conversation and its implications.

item.title: Diclofenac Shows No Benefit for Chemotherapy-Induced Hand-Foot Syndrome
item.description: A study found that diclofenac did not reduce hand-foot syndrome in patients receiving capecitabine-based chemotherapy for cancer.
